snippet.title: Nailcrown - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🔥 Enter the world of Nailcrown

Nailcrown is a savage dark-fantasy boomer shooter with fast gunplay, brutal melee, and dynamic gore. Fight through dark worlds and tear apart hordes of cursed enemies. Fast, violent, and unapologetically old-school. 

👉 Wishlist now on Steam:
